before.title: Matrix Reasoning IQ Test: 3 Worked Examples
before.excerpt: Practise number, direction and shape-combination rules with three original examples; check rules, reject distractors, and explore the free 30-question practice and next steps for reading results.
before.content_md:
## How to solve a matrix reasoning question

A matrix reasoning question asks you to infer a relationship between cells and apply it to a missing cell. Start by observing features such as number, direction and shape separately, then propose a rule, check it against another completed row or column, and only then compare the options. A rule that explains one row by coincidence is not enough.

The three worked examples below were created for this article. They teach ways to check a pattern; they are not answer explanations for FermatMind's test bank. They cannot cover every possible matrix rule.

If you want to try the full practice form, the [free 30-question IQ test and free results](/en/tests/iq-test-intelligence-quotient-assessment) use original visual reasoning questions. Allow about 20 minutes. That is an estimated duration, not a countdown limit established by this guide. This is reasoning practice, rather than a professional intelligence assessment.

If you are choosing between providers before starting, compare [four free IQ test paths and their actual result outputs](/en/articles/online-iq-tests-compared), including demo limits and email requirements.

## A four-step method before you choose an answer

1. **Describe the features separately.** Count the objects, then inspect direction, position, shape and fill. “It looks similar” does not identify a relationship.
2. **State one candidate rule.** For example, “one circle is added at each step to the right.” A precise statement gives you something to test.
3. **Try to disprove it.** Check another completed row or column. If the rule predicts a different known cell, reject it instead of changing it just to preserve your first guess.
4. **Predict the missing cell before comparing options.** Check every relevant feature. An option can have the right direction and the wrong number of objects.

Not every puzzle uses the same relationship across rows and down columns. Check the relationships the given cells support; do not invent a second rule just because the grid has two directions.

## Example 1: count the circles and reject a tempting rule

All the circles in this example have the same shape, size and fill.

| Row | First cell | Second cell | Third cell |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | ○ | ○○ | ○○○ |
| 2 | ○○ | ○○○ | ○○○○ |
| 3 | ○○○ | ○○○○ | ? |

Choose from A: four circles; B: five circles; C: six circles; D: five triangles. Pause before reading the explanation.

**Answer: B, five circles.** Each step to the right adds one circle. The same increase also holds down each column, so both checks predict five circles in the missing cell.

The tempting rule “add the first two counts to get the third” fits row 1: 1 + 2 = 3. It fails in row 2, where 2 + 3 would predict five rather than the four circles actually shown. A rule must account for the known cells, not just one convenient example. D matches the required count but changes the shape without support.

## Example 2: track direction and dot count independently

The arrow turns clockwise by a quarter turn at each step to the right. Test that proposal against the grid rather than assuming it is correct. The symbol “·” represents one dot.

| Row | First cell | Second cell | Third cell |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | ↑ · | → ·· | ↓ ··· |
| 2 | → · | ↓ ·· | ← ··· |
| 3 | ↓ · | ← ·· | ? |

Options: A: ↑ ·; B: ↑ ···; C: → ···; D: ↓ ···.

**Answer: B, an upward arrow and three dots.** In row 3, down → left → up continues the clockwise quarter turns. The other two rows follow the same rule. Down each column, the arrow also advances by one quarter turn. The dot count follows a separate relationship: one dot in column 1, two in column 2 and three in column 3.

A gets the direction right but ignores the dot count. C and D get the count right but fail the arrow rule. Splitting the features makes it possible to identify exactly why an option fails, instead of judging the whole picture at once.

If the arrow rule is clear but an asymmetric arrangement still looks like either a turn or a mirror, continue with [five original rotation and reflection exercises](/en/articles/matrix-reasoning-rotation-vs-reflection). They add named landmarks, movement within a frame, symmetry limits and operation order.

## Example 3: combine symbols, then remove the repeated symbol

In this example, each row combines its first two cells using the same operation. The order of symbols inside a cell does not matter. Compare three candidate operations: keep all symbols, keep only shared symbols, or keep only symbols appearing in exactly one of the first two cells.

| Row | First cell | Second cell | Third cell |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | ○ △ | △ □ | ○ □ |
| 2 | ◇ ○ | ○ ☆ | ◇ ☆ |
| 3 | △ ☆ | ☆ □ | ? |

Options: A: △ ☆ □; B: ☆; C: △ □; D: ○ □.

**Answer: C, triangle and square, under the operation demonstrated by the completed rows.** In row 1, the triangle occurs in both starting cells and disappears; the circle and square each occur once and remain. Row 2 checks the operation: the repeated circle disappears, leaving diamond and star. In row 3, remove the repeated star and retain triangle and square.

A keeps the repeated star, as an “all symbols” operation would. B keeps only the shared star. Neither operation explains the completed rows. D copies row 1's result without using row 3's inputs. This is a teaching example of one combination rule, not a claim that every matrix question uses it or that a finite grid can prove a unique rule among all imaginable rules.

## What to do when none of these rules fits

Return to the features you can actually see. Check whether you missed a change in position, fill or direction, or whether two relationships operate independently. Compare a proposed rule with a completed part of the problem before applying it to the blank. If several options still seem possible, keep that uncertainty; adding an arbitrary exception is not evidence for a solution.

After practice, record one specific observation, such as “I checked the direction but missed the dot count.” A total score cannot recover that observation for you. The [guide to reviewing one reasoning-test session](/en/articles/iq-test-narrative-portrait) explains how to distinguish your own notes from conclusions a score cannot support.

## Turn the examples into a useful practice session

Use new material rather than repeatedly recalling the answers above. For each problem, write the proposed rule, a known cell that checks it, and the feature that rejects a tempting option. On a later problem, see whether that checking step catches an error you otherwise would have missed.

You can change the counts or starting directions in these examples to create a new exercise. Recalculate the full grid and the options; changing a symbol without checking the consequences can produce an ambiguous or inconsistent question. Correctly solving a self-made example is practice in applying that rule, not a standardized assessment.

For a longer routine, follow the [four-week reasoning practice plan](/en/articles/iq-test-growth-guide). Retest research finds that repeated administration can affect cognitive-test performance; it does not validate a particular improvement claim for this practice form. A higher score on familiar material alone does not establish an increase in general intelligence. See [Scharfen, Peters and Holling's retest meta-analysis](https://doi.org/10.1016/j.intell.2018.01.003).

## How this connects to the free FermatMind IQ test

The [current free IQ test](/en/tests/iq-test-intelligence-quotient-assessment) offers 30 original visual reasoning questions, with an estimated duration of about 20 minutes. The test and its results are free. The examples on this page are separate teaching material, so learning them does not provide a key to the test.

After completing and submitting all 30 questions, you can view your IQ score, proportion exceeded, answer accuracy, correct answers, time taken and five-axis ability radar. For example, 18 correct answers give an IQ score of 126, a displayed proportion exceeded of 95.85%, and answer accuracy of 60%. The score and proportion are calculated using the current scoring model, while accuracy is calculated from correct answers. See [IQ Score, Answer Accuracy and Proportion Exceeded](/en/articles/iq-test-score-and-limits-explained) for details.

An online practice result does not establish a clinical diagnosis, educational placement or Mensa eligibility. [Mensa Norway's own practice-test instructions](https://test.mensa.no/Home/Test/en) also distinguish its online test from professional testing; that is a statement about its tool, not evidence that FermatMind has the same norms or measurement properties. For formal assessment, ask a qualified professional which instrument and interpretation fit the purpose.

## Frequently asked questions

### Is a matrix reasoning test the same as a complete IQ assessment?

No. Matrix questions focus on relationships in visual patterns. A broader cognitive assessment can include other tasks and requires evidence for its intended interpretation. FermatMind's original 30-question online form is reasoning practice and does not replace professional assessment.

### Are the FermatMind test and results both free?

Yes. The current original 30-question test and its results are free. Allow about 20 minutes; actual time varies. The worked examples in this article are separate teaching material, not answers to the test bank.

### Should I always add the shapes or rotate them?

No. Those are possible relationships, not universal rules. Check any proposed operation against the completed cells. A rule that fails a known row should be rejected, even if an answer option looks plausible.

### Do these examples reveal the answers to the real test?

No. They were created for this article to demonstrate checking a rule, separating features and rejecting an option. They are not the test bank's answer explanations and do not cover every question type.

### Does a better practice score mean my IQ increased?

Not by itself. Familiarity with items and methods can affect retest performance. Record what changed in your approach and conditions, and use new material to check a strategy; a score increase alone does not establish a change in general intelligence.

snapshot.title: 智商测试怎么做？3道图形矩阵推理例题与解析
snapshot.excerpt: 用三道新编例题练习数量、方向与图形组合，逐步检验规则、排除干扰项；了解免费30题练习与结果解读的下一步。
snapshot.content_md:
## 智商测试里的图形推理题怎么做？

图形矩阵题通常给出若干已知格子，要求根据它们之间的关系补出缺失的一格。解题时，先把数量、方向、形状等特征分开观察，再提出一条能解释已知格子的规则，用另一行或另一列检验，最后比较选项。只碰巧解释一行的规则，还不足以作为答案依据。

下面三道题是为本文新编的教学示例，用来演示怎样检验规则，不是费马测评题库的答案解析，也不能覆盖所有矩阵题型。

如果你想直接体验完整练习，可以进入[免费智商测试：30题，测试与结果均免费](/zh/tests/iq-test-intelligence-quotient-assessment)。当前题本为费马原创视觉推理练习，预计约20分钟；这是预计用时，本指南没有据此确认倒计时截止。它适合观察这次图形推理表现，不能替代专业智力评估。

如果你还在挑选网站，可以先看[四种免费IQ测试的实际结果与选择区别](/zh/articles/online-iq-tests-compared)，确认demo范围、邮箱要求和完成后能拿到什么。

## 先做这四步，再看哪个选项最像

1. **把特征拆开。** 先数数量，再看方向、位置、形状和填充。不要把“看着相似”当成已经找到了关系。
2. **把猜测说成一句可检验的话。** 例如“每向右一格，就增加一个圆”。规则越具体，越容易查出哪里不成立。
3. **主动找反例。** 用另一条完整的行或列检查。如果规则预测的结果与已知格子不符，就换一个假设，不要为保住第一印象临时加例外。
4. **先预测缺格，再比较选项。** 逐个核对相关特征。一个选项可能方向正确，数量却不对。

并不是每道题的横向关系与纵向关系都相同。核对题目实际支持的关系，不要因为有行有列，就强行编出第二条规则。

## 例题一：数量递增，为什么不能只看第一行？

这道示例中的圆形大小、形状和填充相同。

| 行 | 第一格 | 第二格 | 第三格 |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | ○ | ○○ | ○○○ |
| 2 | ○○ | ○○○ | ○○○○ |
| 3 | ○○○ | ○○○○ | ？ |

选项为：A，四个圆；B，五个圆；C，六个圆；D，五个三角形。先试着解释，再往下看。

**答案是B，五个圆。** 每向右一格增加一个圆；沿每一列向下检查，也都是增加一个圆。两种检查都指向缺格里应有五个圆。

一个容易产生的猜测是“第三格等于前两格数量相加”。它在第一行成立：1＋2＝3；第二行却不成立，因为2＋3应为5，而已知第三格只有4个圆。因此，不能因为一条规则恰好解释第一行，就直接套到最后一行。D虽然数量正确，却无依据地把圆变成了三角形。

## 例题二：方向与数量同时变化，分开核对

先提出一个方向假设：每向右一步，箭头顺时针转四分之一圈。再用格子检验它。符号“·”代表一个点。

| 行 | 第一格 | 第二格 | 第三格 |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | ↑ · | → ·· | ↓ ··· |
| 2 | → · | ↓ ·· | ← ··· |
| 3 | ↓ · | ← ·· | ？ |

选项为：A，↑ ·；B，↑ ···；C，→ ···；D，↓ ···。

**答案是B，向上的箭头和三个点。** 第三行的方向依次为下、左、上，符合顺时针每次转四分之一圈；另外两行也符合。沿列向下看，箭头同样每次转四分之一圈。点数则是另一条关系：第一列一个点，第二列两个点，第三列三个点。

A只顾到了方向，漏看点数；C和D虽然点数正确，方向却不符合规则。把两个特征分开，就能具体说明一个选项错在哪里，不必依赖整张图给你的第一感觉。

若你能跟上箭头方向，却仍分不清不对称图形是转动还是照镜子，可以继续看[旋转与镜像的五组原创图解](/zh/articles/matrix-reasoning-rotation-vs-reflection)：追踪标记、拆开位置变化，并检查对称形和操作次序。

## 例题三：图形组合，重复出现的符号如何处理？

这道示例要求每行用同一种操作，将前两格组合为第三格；格内符号的排列顺序不影响判断。比较三种假设：保留所有符号、只保留共有符号，或只保留在前两格中出现一次的符号。

| 行 | 第一格 | 第二格 | 第三格 |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | ○ △ | △ □ | ○ □ |
| 2 | ◇ ○ | ○ ☆ | ◇ ☆ |
| 3 | △ ☆ | ☆ □ | ？ |

选项为：A，△ ☆ □；B，☆；C，△ □；D，○ □。

**按照前两行演示的操作，答案是C，三角形和正方形。** 第一行里，三角形在前两格都出现，组合后消失；只出现一次的圆和正方形留下。第二行可以验证：重复的圆消失，菱形与星形留下。第三行因此应去掉重复的星形，留下三角形和正方形。

A把重复的星形也保留了，相当于取所有符号；B只留下共有的星形。这两种操作都不能解释前两行。D照搬第一行的结果，没有依据第三行的输入。这只是某一种组合规则的教学示例，不意味着所有图形题都这样组合，也不意味着有限的格子能排除所有想象得到的其他规则。

## 三种规则都不适用时，怎么办？

回到已知格子，检查是否漏看了位置、填充或方向，是否有两条相互独立的关系。先用完整部分核对假设，再把它用于缺格。如果几个选项仍然都像是可能的，就保留这种不确定；临时添加一条例外，并不会让答案更有依据。

练习后，可以记下一条具体观察，例如“我核对了方向，却漏看点数”。总分不能替你还原这个过程。[图形推理测试后的复盘指南](/zh/articles/iq-test-narrative-portrait)进一步说明，哪些内容是自己的作答观察，哪些结论不能从一次总分里推出。

## 怎样把例题变成有效的练习？

换用新材料，不要只重复回忆上面的答案。每道题记录三件事：自己提出的规则、哪一个已知格子能检验它、哪一个特征排除了容易误选的答案。换一道新题后，再看这一步检查是否帮助你发现了原本会漏掉的矛盾。

你也可以改变例题中的数量或起始方向，自编一道练习。但要重新计算整个表格和选项；只替换一个符号而不核对其他格子，可能造出歧义或不一致的题。能解出自己编的题，只能说明你练习了那条规则，并不是一次标准化能力测评。

想安排更长的练习，可以参考[四周推理练习计划](/zh/articles/iq-test-growth-guide)。关于认知测验重复施测的研究发现，重测本身可能影响表现；这不能证明某个训练方案对费马题本的效果，也不能仅凭熟悉材料上的分数上升，就判定一般智力提高。可参阅[Scharfen等人的重测效应元分析](https://doi.org/10.1016/j.intell.2018.01.003)。

## 免费智商测试与这些例题是什么关系？

[费马当前的免费IQ测试](/zh/tests/iq-test-intelligence-quotient-assessment)提供30道原创视觉推理题，预计约20分钟，测试与结果均免费。本文例题是另外编写的教学材料，学会它们不等于拿到了测评答案。

完成30道题并提交后，可以查看IQ得分、超过人群比例、答题正确率、答对题数、用时和五维能力雷达。例如，答对18题时，IQ得分为126分，超过人群比例显示95.85%，答题正确率为60%。分数和比例按当前评分模型换算，正确率按答对题数计算。详细说明见[IQ分数、正确率与超过人群比例的区别](/zh/articles/iq-test-score-and-limits-explained)。

一次在线练习不能用于临床诊断、教育安置或门萨资格认定。[门萨挪威自己的练习说明](https://test.mensa.no/Home/Test/en)也区分了在线练习与专业测试；这是该工具对自身的说明，不能拿来证明费马具有相同的常模或测量性质。如果有正式评估需求，应向合格专业人员说明用途，由其选择适当工具和解释方法。

## 常见问题

### 图形矩阵推理等于完整的智力评估吗？

不等于。图形矩阵题关注视觉模式之间的关系，更广的认知评估还可能包含其他任务，并需要与用途相适应的解释证据。费马原创30题在线题本属于推理练习，不能替代专业评估。

### 费马智商测试和结果都是免费的吗？

是。当前原创30题的测试与结果均免费，预计约20分钟，实际用时因人而异。本文例题是独立编写的教学材料，不是测评题库的答案。

### 图形题是不是都用相加或旋转来解？

不是。这些只是可能的关系，不是通用公式。任何假设都应放回已知格子中核对；如果不能解释完整的一行，即使某个选项看起来合理，也不能据此认定规则成立。

### 本文例题会泄露真实测评的答案吗？

不会。三道例题为本文新编，用来演示检验规则、拆分特征和排除选项；它们不是测评题库的答案解析，也不覆盖全部题型。

### 练习后分数提高，说明智商提高了吗？

不能仅凭这一点判断。熟悉题目或方法可能影响重测表现。可以记录自己的检查方法和作答条件发生了什么变化，再用新材料检验策略；分数上升本身不能证明一般智力改变。

faq_items.answer: 不能仅凭这一点判断。熟悉题目或方法可能影响重测表现。可以记录自己的检查方法和作答条件发生了什么变化，再用新材料检验策略；分数上升本身不能证明一般智力改变。

snapshot.title: 免费在线智商测试怎么选？四种模式与实际结果比较
snapshot.excerpt: 从免费完成后能看到什么出发，比较四条具体路径，区分实际观察、提供方说明与正式评估用途。
snapshot.content_md:
选在线智商测试，先看你希望最后拿到什么：只想试几道题、想知道答对多少、想体验多种题型，还是要一份被机构认可的结果。它们都可能叫“IQ测试”，免费部分的输出却不一样。

如果只想短暂体验图形题，可以选123test的8题demo；想做30题视觉推理并查看正确数，可以选费马；想尝试更长的混合题型，可以看ARealMe快速版；想按明确倒计时练习，可以进入挪威门萨。这里四条无监考练习路径的结果，都不能作为门萨入会资格或替代专业评估。

本文由**费马测试FermatMind**发布，费马也是比较对象之一。2026年10月16日，我们用合成任意选择走完了四条英文免费路径，核对访问条件和结果字段；没有用生成的分数比较能力或准确性，没有购买报告或创建第三方账号。ARealMe简中说明另行核读，但没有据此宣称不同语言的分数等值。

## 免费做完之后，实际看到了什么？

下表的结果来自本次实际完成路径；题量与预计用时采用对应提供方说明。预计用时不等于已经验证的强制截止。

| 具体模式 | 题量与时间 | 本次免费输出 | 选择时的取舍 |
|---|---|---|---|
| [费马原创视觉推理](/zh/tests/iq-test-intelligence-quotient-assessment) | 30题；预计约20分钟 | 得分、模型换算的超过人群比例、正确率、正确数、总用时、题组雷达 | 聚焦视觉练习；五轴图不等于五项能力均有独立测量 |
| [123test Culture fair demo](https://www.123test.com/iq-test/) | 8道图形题；这条短路径未见倒计时 | IQ估计区间，以及完整产品入口 | 适合先体验；不包含整个付费评估与报告 |
| [ARealMe 2026快速版](https://www.arealme.com/iq/cn/) | 49题；预计15—20分钟 | 英文路径显示分数和版本参照，提示继续70题 | 详细画像不在快速版内；完整版共119题 |
| [挪威门萨在线练习](https://test.mensa.no/Home/Test/en) | 35题；实际有25分钟倒计时 | 本次合成路径显示“低于100”的范围提示，没有精确数字 | 可练计时作答；不能保证每次都给精确IQ值 |

本次四条英文路径都不需要邮箱、注册或付款就能看到免费结果。这个结论只覆盖表中模式与本次会话，不能扩大成每个品牌的全部产品免费。本次所见结果页也没有逐题答案解析。

## 按自己的目标选择下一步

**只想先做一小段，再决定是否投入更多时间。** 可以用123test的8题非语言demo。我们在结束后的年龄、性别、地区和教育资料处全部留空，仍可进入结果页。它的入口还列有另一套10题Classical demo及完整付费产品，本次没有完成它们。免费demo能出结果，不代表完整报告也已经免费解锁。

**想看本次视觉题答对多少，而不只拿一个数字。** 费马当前30题结果会显示正确数和正确率，并给出得分、总用时与题组图。结果上方有可选邮箱找回表单；本次没有填写，也能阅读结果。当前得分由正确数按预设分段换算，“超过人群比例”由正态参考模型计算，不是实际参测者排名。五轴图里的逻辑、语言轴明确标为未测、以0占位，不能读成这两项能力为零；其他题组也先按本次正确数理解。公式细节见[分数、正确率与比例说明](/zh/articles/iq-test-score-and-limits-explained)。

**希望接触更长、更多样的题型。** 可以考虑ARealMe快速版。我们在英文路径的年龄、性别两栏均选择不愿透露后，看到了结果。当前模型标为n20261015a；提供方说明参照的是近期参与者，不能当成全球人口排名。完整版画像、可选证书的免费范围只核对了公开说明，本轮没有取得这些输出。决定继续前，先确认自己愿不愿意投入额外题量。

**想练习明确限时下的取舍与回看。** 挪威门萨的实际题页有倒计时，也能返回前题；结束时会提醒利用剩余时间检查。介绍页说明结果为指示值，但本次完成后只返回低于100的范围提示。我们提前结束，没有独立验证计时归零后的行为。选择它可以体验这种练习形式，不应据此期待某个确定分数或入会资格。

## 想学解法，先选择有解释的教学材料

结果摘要与逐题解法解决的是不同问题。如果你关心“为什么这条规律成立”，可以先读[三道原创矩阵推理示例](/zh/articles/iq-test-tool-guide)，再做[旋转与镜像的五组图解](/zh/articles/matrix-reasoning-rotation-vs-reflection)。它们是单独编写、有解析的教学材料，不提供上述测评题库的答案。

用手机前，先确认整张图和所有选项都能看清。桌面走通不代表每种任务在每台设备上一样好用；本次没有用实体手机重新完成全部四套题。作答时按当前工具实际的返回、继续与计时规则操作，不把另一家的恢复功能套过来。

## 需要入会或正式证明时，怎样选？

先问接收结果的机构。门萨练习与入会测试要分别看：[英国门萨免费Workout](https://mensa.org.uk/test-your-iq/)明确不提供IQ分数，而其[在线监考服务](https://mensa.org.uk/mensa-online-iq-test/)有自己的居住地、设备与监考条件。不能仅凭“在线”二字判断用途。更多具体区别见[门萨免费练习与入会指南](/zh/articles/mensa-iq-test-free-practice-vs-admission)。

如果学校、临床人员或其他机构要求正式评估，应先确认接受的工具、语言、适龄范围、施测人员及报告。免费分数或一张练习证书不能替你证明对方认可。

也不要把几家网站的数字相减当成进步，或取平均当成“更准的IQ”。题目、参照、语言和作答条件不同，没有相应可比证据时不能直接互换。本轮核的是能取得什么输出，没有建立“最准”排名。

## 来源与本次覆盖范围

- [费马当前入口](/zh/tests/iq-test-intelligence-quotient-assessment)：英文30题合成路径及结果已走通；预计20分钟不作为已验证的硬截止。
- [123test免费demo选择页](https://www.123test.com/iq-test/)：实际完成8题Culture fair；10题Classical和完整付费报告未测。
- [ARealMe英文](https://www.arealme.com/iq/en/)与[简中说明](https://www.arealme.com/iq/cn/)：英文快速版完成；完整版、证书及7天同设备恢复仅为提供方说明，本轮未亲测。
- [挪威门萨说明及练习](https://test.mensa.no/Home/Test/en)：合成选择18—50年龄组走完；倒计时、返回与范围结果为实际观察，不能推广为每个年龄都适用。

产品可能在核查日期后调整。本文不展示第三方题目、正确答案、私有结果链接或真实用户资料。若决定使用本站视觉练习，可以在有完整空闲时间时[开始费马免费30题智商测试](/zh/tests/iq-test-intelligence-quotient-assessment)。

## 常见问题

### 哪些免费智商测试不留邮箱也能看结果？

本次核查的英文路径中，费马原创30题、123test的8题Culture fair demo、ARealMe快速版和挪威门萨练习都无需邮箱或注册即可看免费结果。结论不涵盖各品牌全部模式和付费报告。

### ARealMe快速版包含完整画像吗？

本次快速版结果提示继续70题查看画像。提供方说明完整版共119题，含画像和可选免费证书；本轮没有取得这些完整输出。

### 挪威门萨一定显示精确IQ数字吗？

不能这样保证。本次完整合成路径只显示低于100的范围提示。介绍页的分数范围不能保证每次都有精确数字，练习成绩也不是入会资格。

### 哪个在线IQ测试最准？

本文的访问与输出核查不能建立这种排名。准确性需要具体工具、版本、人群及用途的测量证据；能看到一个分数或走完免费路径，本身不提供这些证据。

snapshot.title: Free Online IQ Tests Compared: What Results Do You Get?
snapshot.excerpt: A practical comparison of four free online IQ test paths, separating observed results from provider descriptions and formal assessment needs.
snapshot.content_md:
Choose an online IQ test by the result you want to receive. A short demo, a longer mixed-question exercise and a timed visual challenge are different products, even when each uses “IQ” in its title. Check the exact mode before investing your time.

For a brief visual demo, try 123test's eight-question option. For a 30-question visual exercise with correct-answer counts, try FermatMind. For a longer mix of questions, consider ARealMe's Quick mode, with further questions required for its detailed profile. For an official Mensa practice activity with a countdown, use Mensa Norway. None of these four unsupervised practice paths establishes Mensa membership eligibility or replaces a professional assessment.

This comparison is published by **FermatMind**, which provides one of the tools below. On 16 October 2026 we completed the four English free paths using synthetic, arbitrary responses to inspect access and result fields. We did not compare the resulting scores, assess measurement accuracy, buy reports or create third-party accounts. Chinese ARealMe instructions were also checked; completing one language does not establish equivalent scores in another.

## What did the free paths actually show?

The outputs below were observed in those sessions. Question counts and duration estimates come from the linked providers; an estimate is not a verified deadline.

| Specific option | Questions and time | Free output observed | Main tradeoff |
|---|---|---|---|
| [FermatMind original visual form](/en/tests/iq-test-intelligence-quotient-assessment) | 30; about 20 minutes estimated | Score, model-derived proportion exceeded, accuracy, correct count, total time and item-group radar | Focused visual practice; the radar does not establish five independently measured abilities |
| [123test Culture fair demo](https://www.123test.com/iq-test/) | 8 visual questions; no countdown observed on this short path | An estimated IQ interval, followed by links to fuller products | Brief preview; not the full paid assessment or report |
| [ARealMe 2026 Quick](https://www.arealme.com/iq/en/) | 49; 15–20 minutes estimated | Score and versioned reference information; invitation to answer 70 more questions | Detailed profile is beyond Quick; Complete has 119 questions |
| [Mensa Norway online practice](https://test.mensa.no/Home/Test/en) | 35; an actual 25-minute countdown | In our synthetic session, a “below 100” range message rather than an exact number | Timed practice; do not assume every completion gives a precise IQ number |

All four observed paths reached a free result without an email, account registration or payment. That statement applies to these modes and sessions, not every service offered by each brand. We did not observe item-by-item answer explanations on those result pages.

## Which option fits your next step?

**“I want a short preview before committing to a longer test.”** Choose the 123test eight-question Culture fair demo. We left its demographic fields blank and could still view the result. Its landing page also offers a separate ten-question Classical demo and paid full products; we did not complete those. Selecting a free demo does not unlock every report sold by 123test.

**“I want to see how many visual questions I answered correctly.”** The current FermatMind form supplies that count and accuracy alongside its displayed score. An email recovery form appears above the results, but leaving it empty did not block viewing them. The score uses predefined correct-answer anchors, while “proportion exceeded” uses a normal reference model; it is not a ranking of observed participants. The five-axis chart marks logic and verbal axes as unmeasured zero placeholders. Use the actual item-group counts, rather than treating the chart as a comprehensive cognitive assessment. Our [score and accuracy explanation](/en/articles/iq-test-score-and-limits-explained) gives the calculation details.

**“I would rather try a longer mix than only visual matrices.”** ARealMe Quick is an option. We could decline both demographic answers and view the result. Its current model is labelled n20261015a. The provider describes its reference as recent participants rather than a representative world population. Complete-mode profiles and certificates were checked against its public description, not obtained in this review; decide whether you want that extra length before continuing.

**“I want to practise working under a stated deadline.”** Mensa Norway displayed a countdown and allowed returning to earlier questions before finishing. Its introduction describes an indicative score, but our completed path returned only a lower-range message. We finished early; we did not independently test what happens when the full timer expires. Choose this for its practice format, not a promise of a particular result or membership.

## If you want explanations, start with teaching material

A result summary and a worked solution serve different needs. If your goal is to understand why a visual rule works, read our [three introductory matrix examples](/en/articles/iq-test-tool-guide), then the [rotation and reflection exercises](/en/articles/matrix-reasoning-rotation-vs-reflection). These are original teaching materials with explanations, separate from the scored bank. They do not reveal answers to the four providers' tests.

On a phone, check that the whole diagram and every option are legible before starting. A desktop completion does not prove that every task is equally usable on every device. We did not complete all four tests again on physical phones. Follow the selected tool's actual navigation and timer; do not assume that another site's return or resume controls exist here.

## If you need membership or formal documentation

Start with the organisation that will accept the result. Mensa practice is distinct from admission: British Mensa's [free Workout](https://mensa.org.uk/test-your-iq/) explicitly offers no IQ score, while its [supervised online service](https://mensa.org.uk/mensa-online-iq-test/) has its own residence, equipment and proctoring conditions. “Online” alone does not tell you whether a service is accepted. Our [Mensa practice and admission guide](/en/articles/mensa-iq-test-free-practice-vs-admission) explains those distinctions.

For a school, clinical or other formal assessment requirement, establish the required instrument, language, age suitability, practitioner and report with the receiving organisation or qualified professional. A practice certificate or a free score cannot establish acceptance.

Do not subtract or average scores across these sites. Different questions, references, languages and conditions make the numbers non-interchangeable without relevant comparability evidence. This review tests what a user can access; it does not identify the “most accurate” tool.

## Sources and coverage limits

- [FermatMind current form](/en/tests/iq-test-intelligence-quotient-assessment): full English synthetic path and result observed; the estimated duration is not a verified hard limit.
- [123test demo chooser](https://www.123test.com/iq-test/): eight-question Culture fair demo completed; ten-question Classical demo and paid full reports not tested.
- [ARealMe English](https://www.arealme.com/iq/en/) and [Simplified Chinese](https://www.arealme.com/iq/cn/): English Quick completed; Complete, certificate and seven-day resume remain provider descriptions, not hands-on findings here.
- [Mensa Norway instructions and practice](https://test.mensa.no/Home/Test/en): full synthetic path in its 18–50 age option; countdown, return controls and range-only result observed. This selected bracket is not evidence of suitability for every age.

Details can change after the check date. No third-party test questions, answer keys, private result links or real users' records are reproduced here. If you choose our visual exercise, [start the free 30-question FermatMind test](/en/tests/iq-test-intelligence-quotient-assessment) when you have uninterrupted time.

## Frequently asked questions

### Which free IQ tests let me see results without an email?

In our checked English sessions, FermatMind's original 30-question form, 123test's eight-question Culture fair demo, ARealMe Quick and Mensa Norway practice reached free results without an email or account registration. This does not cover every mode or paid report from those providers.

### Does ARealMe Quick include the complete profile?

Our Quick result invited us to answer 70 more questions for the profile. The provider describes Complete as 119 questions with a profile and optional free certificate; those outputs were not obtained in this review.

### Will Mensa Norway always display an exact IQ number?

Do not assume so. Our completed synthetic path returned a below-100 range message. Its introductory score description does not guarantee an exact number for every result, and practice does not qualify you for membership.

### Which tool is the most accurate?

This access-and-output comparison cannot establish that. Accuracy requires evidence for a particular instrument, population, version and use; seeing a score or completing a free path does not provide that evidence.
